Bill.BriefDescription: Ensuring work jurisdictions of unions are respected and preserved in public works contracting.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to public works contracting; and adding a newsection to chapter 39.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 39.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: When the state or a municipality contracting for construction ofany kind hires or is signatory to a contractor who is party to aproject labor agreement, the contracting entity must ensure that anyexisting work jurisdiction of a union on the property is respected andpreserved.
